title: MCP Servers
description: The <0>Model Context Protocol</0> enables communication with local or remote running MCP servers that provide additional tools and resources to extend Orbital's capabilities.

enableToggle.title: Enable MCP Servers
enableToggle.description: Turn this ON to let Axon Code use tools from connected MCP servers. This gives Axon Code more capabilities. If you don't plan to use these extra tools, turn it OFF to help reduce API token costs.

enableServerCreation.title: Enable MCP Server Creation
enableServerCreation.description: Enable this to have Axon Code help you build <1>new</1> custom MCP servers. <0>Learn about server creation</0>
enableServerCreation.hint: Hint: To reduce API token costs, disable this setting when you are not actively asking Axon Code to create a new MCP server.

learnMoreEditingSettings: Learn more about editing MCP settings files

networkTimeout.label: Network Timeout
networkTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for server responses

deleteDialog.title: Delete MCP Server
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete the MCP server "{{serverName}}"? This action cannot be undone.

serversSection.title: Installed servers
serversSection.empty: No MCP servers installed yet. Add one from the suggestions below or edit your config.

migration.title: Migrate MCP Servers
migration.description: Import MCP server entries from Cursor, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop. Imported servers are added to your global Orbital MCP settings and start connecting immediately.
migration.empty: No MCP servers found in Cursor, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop. Install one of those clients, or add servers with the global MCP settings editor.
